propositions: Production bugs occurred when code bypassed canonical store write seams by using raw git add/commit/rm operations outside sanctioned entry points

A two-layer deterministic CI lint (Python AST + workflow/shell cwd-aware scanning) must flag all raw git mutations except those within seam internals, maintenance commands, or disposable sandboxes, sanctioned by inline '# raw-git-ok: <reason>' markers with mandatory reasons

The lint must resolve argv by local intra-function tracking (list literals, local variables, splatting) and fail-closed on opaque argv, covering the codebase's own write idioms and preventing future bypasses
Authoritative hit inventory is produced by report-mode bootstrap scan (not prose enumeration); every hit must be remediated or marked with a reason before enforcement is enabled

Layer W (workflows/shell) must detect git mutations only when the same step establishes tracker context via cd, git -C, or working-directory into .tickets-tracker paths, avoiding false positives on non-tracker commits
